decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core modular sensing platform in a growing and investing firm, there is no clear sign of performance below aspiration and available slack supports keeping this still-new module on the market.

This module builds directly on the established automation offer and its dedicated product page suggests meaningful commitment, so absent evidence of a shortfall management would retain it rather than reallocate resources.

A solid state relay module fits the firm's established control architecture and complementary product logic, and with expansion and broad in-house capabilities the firm can afford to continue this uncertain but related product.

The server room monitoring kit leverages the firm's existing sensing and interface resources and, with no observed failure against aspirations, a growing German electronics firm would typically keep such a related solution while learning from the market.
